name: browser-control
description: Dialog 4G and Huawei B310 router control dashboard
author: browser-control

scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run build:electron
scripts.release:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build && npm run prepare:standalone && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
